definition_section6_2_verbatim: Thin identifies the same move, on the same material; gives the same reason why it is a failure; and passes the repair test: if every criticism thin made were fixed, the failure Organon treated as decisive would be gone.
Thin makes partial contact but does not meet all three conditions. It reaches a component, or the surrounding failures but not the mechanism as Organon describes it.
Nothing in thin's reasoning reaches it.
